items.title: Daryl Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2024
items.q: I know Mike Renzi and all the people out there now that people use

ctx.x: Do you think you accompany significantly differently when you accompany another singer?

I love doing that actually. With good singers. And I am careful, I mean I know Mike Renzi and all the people out there now that people use. But I pride myself in thinking that I know to stay out of their way. I don’t have the chops to play in every key faking it and playing a lot of full fingers all the time. But for a singer and then for accompanying myself, that’s not mostly what you want.
